prose_updates.tldr: A randomized recurrent-event trial identifies separately capped baseline and residual margins while leaving their dependence unknown, and the raw recurrent paths remain unbounded. The externally prespecified sensitivity restriction \(B+W\le H\) creates a Ferrers transport problem and is not implied by separate capping. Dahl2008, Theorem 4, supplies only the reindexed staircase feasibility support. The cap-fibre response-tree construction proves that every feasible triple coupling preserves the observed law and is attainable even after imposing the published uncapped residual no-carry-over equality. The resulting sharp endpoints and common-law value polytope yield exact deterministic and randomized minimax regret; in the cap-three witness the unique randomized rule \((9/16,5/16,1/8)\) has regret \(17/160\), strictly below the best deterministic regret \(7/40\), while scalar intervals select a different deterministic threshold. One confidence-polytope inversion covers the whole value set and every deterministic or randomized robust optimizer at Hall, policy, and mixture ties. Uniformly shrinking censoring-adjusted inference is impossible under the frozen pointwise-overlap assumptions: in the cap-three two-point experiment, any uniformly honest randomized-optimizer region must contain both \(e_3\) and \((9/16,5/16,1/8)\) with limiting lower probability at least \(1-2\alpha\). A constructive efficient procedure under quantitative overlap and nuisance-rate conditions remains open.

project_justification.gap: The closest recurrent-event switching analysis supplies a published uncapped no-carry-over equality, threshold-wise scalar sharp bounds, and deterministic decision criteria. Dahl2008, Theorem 4, separately settles staircase fixed-margin feasibility. Neither line proves that every capped coupling has an observed-law-preserving cap-fibre lift within the published raw-no-carry-over subclass, identifies the common latent value law across a threshold menu, computes deterministic and randomized minimax regret, or supplies confidence inversion for the full deterministic and randomized optimizer correspondences together with a sharp vanishing-information limitation.
project_justification.fill: The formal kernel combines the attributed Dahl2008 feasibility certificate with an explicit raw-path cap-fibre lift, proves sharp transfer to the published uncapped no-carry-over subclass intersected with the capacity restriction, derives atom-correct endpoints and the common-coupling value polytope, computes deterministic and randomized regret with the eligibility-greedy support oracle, supplies the exact cap-three reversal and unique optimal mixture, and gives simultaneous confidence-polytope inversion for the whole value set and both optimizer correspondences. An explicit cap-three two-law experiment proves that pointwise censoring positivity alone cannot support uniformly shrinking randomized-optimizer inference.

prose_updates.related_work: JanvinRyalenSarvetStensrud2025 Assumption 1 supplies the uncapped residual no-carry-over equality, while Proposition 1 and the decision section supply threshold-wise scalar sharp bounds and deterministic regime logic. The cap-fibre construction here shows that, after intersecting with the externally prespecified restriction \(B+W\le H\), every feasible capped coupling remains attainable in that published raw-no-carry-over subclass; the new content is therefore the capacity-constrained backward-deficit endpoint, common-law value, and deterministic and randomized regret geometry, not a retreat to a different causal class. Strassen1965 gives the general support-constrained coupling principle. More directly, Dahl2008, Theorem 4 and Section 3, already characterize fixed-margin staircase feasibility and constructions; after reversing the row order, the antidiagonal Hall criterion is exactly that specialization and is not claimed as new. ZhangRichardson2025 motivates separate treatment of weak and strict events for discrete sums. HoffmanVeinott1993 informs the staircase greedy argument, which is used here as a specialized support oracle rather than freestanding algorithmic novelty. RichardsonRobins2013 supplies FFRCISTG semantics, and GreseleEtAl2022 frames the local-to-global causal-marginal obstruction resolved by the observed-law-preserving lift. MontielOleaQiuStoye2026 shows the decision relevance of joint payoff geometry and randomization; the present geometry is the image of one capped transport law. ChernozhukovHongTamer2007, AndrewsSoares2010, and Gafarov2025 inform confidence inversion at binding inequalities and changing faces. The randomized envelope inversion here is set-theoretic and remains valid at mixture ties, while its two-point limit makes explicit why pointwise overlap does not imply uniform shrinkage. BaerStrawdermanErtefaie2023 supports factual-arm sequential coarsening identification.
prose_updates.technical_internal_limitation: The primitive counts are raw, nonnegative-integer-valued, and not globally bounded by \(H\). The condition \(B+W\le H\) constrains the separately capped prefix burden and switched residual and remains a substantive sensitivity restriction. The cap-fibre lift may draw an uncapped switched residual above \(H\) when \(W=H\); this is essential for preserving the published uncapped standard residual law and is why the theorem asserts equality only after capping. A finite-reserve mechanism gives a compatible class, but no such mechanism or clinically defensible cap has been established for SPRINT. Dahl's feasibility criterion can reject a proposed cap statistically but cannot establish clinical credibility. The response-tree theorem preserves the original arm-specific sequential censoring law on factual at-risk histories and does not assume independence between censoring and the entire cross-world response tree. Finally, pointwise censoring positivity permits vanishing-information sequences. The negative uniform-inference results therefore rule out uniformly shrinking confidence regions for the whole value set and for either deterministic or randomized optimizer correspondences under the frozen class; constructive efficient inference requires additional quantitative overlap and nuisance-remainder conditions.
prose_updates.honest_scope: The proved scope consists of atom-correct endpoints, a raw-path cap-fibre causal lift preserving factual-arm sequential censoring, exact sharp transfer to the published uncapped residual no-carry-over subclass intersected with \(B+W\le H\), the complete common-law value and support characterization, deterministic and randomized minimax regret, the rational recommendation reversal and unique optimal mixture, and confidence-polytope inversion for the whole value set and all deterministic and randomized robust optimizers, including Hall and policy ties. The candidate randomized regret is explicitly \(H\tau\)-Lipschitz in the policy mixture at total candidate mass \(\tau\). Dahl2008, Theorem 4, is used only as attributed feasibility support. Uniform inference is resolved negatively under the frozen assumptions by vanishing-information witnesses, including a cap-three pair forcing every uniformly honest randomized-optimizer region to contain both \(e_3\) and \((9/16,5/16,1/8)\) with limiting lower probability at least \(1-2\alpha\). A nonvacuous cross-fitted or efficient construction under explicit quantitative assignment, survival, censoring-overlap, and nuisance-rate conditions remains open. SPRINT is only a conditional capped-loss consumer: a mechanism and cap must be justified externally and prespecified at \(k=300\), and the application is rejected if no credible capacity interpretation exists or the censoring-adjusted Hall confidence system is infeasible.

sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: The finite vectors \((r_{bt},q_w)\) are identified under factual-arm sequential coarsening at random and may be estimated with censoring adjustment. Their simultaneous confidence region feeds one perspective polytope whose images cover the whole value set and all deterministic and randomized minimax rules without excluding Hall or policy ties. Under the frozen pointwise-positivity class, uniformly shrinking inference is impossible, including for randomized optimizers. A constructive cross-fitted procedure remains open only after adding quantitative effective assignment, survival, and censoring overlap together with explicit nuisance-rate and second-order remainder conditions.

statement_notes.consumer: A capped switching analysis can use this common first-stage perspective polytope to cover every compatible value vector and deterministic robust threshold; the randomized-confidence theorem applies the same object to all mixed minimax rules.

statement_notes.justification: The same first-stage event covers every randomized minimizer by lower-versus-upper regret envelopes, while the explicit Lipschitz bound and two-point witness delimit uniform informativeness.
statement_notes.gap: Neither scalar endpoint inversion nor deterministic optimizer coverage addresses the policy simplex, randomized ties, or the possibility that two unique mixed optimizers are observationally indistinguishable under vanishing censoring overlap.
statement_notes.consumer: A robust capped switching analysis can report all mixed minimax rules compatible with the first-stage region and must disclose when pointwise overlap prevents that region from shrinking uniformly.
